page.layout: One printed page, one text column in the centre, with no notes beside it. Page number 65 at the top right. Nothing printed above the text as running head. Below the last line: catchword "per-" at right, and a signature "E" at lower centre. Only edge fragments and stains at the margins, which are not transcribed.

main_text.l: ἀρχιεπισκόπου[?] Ἀδριανῷ[?] τῷ νεωτέρῳ Πάπᾳ. Ita tamen vt deinceps de laicis in eadem Eccle-
fia Episcopus contra sanctorum Patrum statuta
nullatenus ordinetur, & omnis illa mala con-
suetudo ab inde penitus amputetur; iuxta capi-
tulum, quod super hac re in Venerabili Synodo,
tempore scilicet decessoris nostri Adriani iunio-
ris Papæ, Constantinopoli habita, est congruen-
tissime promulgatum. Est vero Actionis 10.
Canon 5. Venerabilem nuncupat, & con-
culcari mandat? Sed Photius in corruptis
vocat ἀδίκους Συνόδους, iniquas Synodos, &
Canonem ad Septimam Synodum sub Adri-
ano Primo Tarasij tempore refert. Quid
tum? multa alia dixit Photius, quæ nec ab
ipsis Schismaticis probantur. Hominem Ni-
colao, & Adriano Pontificibus infensissi-
mum pro sui defensione, mirum est non
peiora pronunciasse. Vide quæ nos in Ope-
re de Consensione Occidentalis, atque Orien-
talis Ecclesiæ lib. 2. cap. 3. 4. & 5. diximus.
Quibus colligitur, Synodum hanc a Photio
confictam prorsus fuisse, uti & aliam, quam
in Nicolaum, tot aduersus Romanam Ec-
clesiam criminationes ementitus pro arbi-
trio concinnauerat. Quare nec suspicio
mea vana est, Ioannem Pontificem, licet
antea videretur reconciliari Photio, vt
Imperatori Basilio morem gereret, comperta
per-

page.notes: The Greek words at the start of the page are hard to read on the scan: ἀρχιεπισκόπου and Ἀδριανῷ are my best reading and are marked [?]. The Greek in the 'vocat' sentence (ἀδίκους Συνόδους) is also a reading from the scan. The left edge shows fragments of the neighbouring page and the right side shows stains; neither is transcribed. The word "iunio-ris" is printed with a hyphen at the line end and is kept as printed.
